<thought>The mass spectrum shows a base peak at m/z 180.042, which in positive‑mode ESI is most likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.03498 Da. Searching for a formula that matches this mass and is consistent with the observed ~10 % M+1 intensity (≈9–10 carbons) yields C₉H₇O₄ (exact mass 179.034435 Da), which is within 3 ppm of the target mass and predicts an [M+H]⁺ at 180.04171 Da, matching the observed peak.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
